title: Sparse prime surgery in completely multiplicative sequences: Normality, rare-event realization and optimal repair
summary: We study how changing prime signs affects fixed-word frequencies, rare-event laws and extremes of completely multiplicative sequences. The cost is $d_\sigma(f,g)=\sum_{f(p)\ne g(p)}p^{-\sigma}$. A known theorem of Frantzikinakis-Lemańczyk-de la Rue preserves normality at finite $d_1$; we give its elementary specialization. Using explicit arithmetic inputs from Long runs, we then establish three families of results.
